post-binds-new-entry: routes/entries.ts post: UPDATE attachments SET entry_id and INSERT INTO entry_mentions. The entry is created in the same transaction, so nothing cached has seen it.
unposted-upload-sweep: routes/attachments.ts sweepExpiredAttachments: DELETE FROM attachments ... entry_id IS NULL. An unbound upload belongs to no entry.
tenant-deletion: deletion-worker.ts: the whole community goes, and no reader remains.
erasure-rewrite-mentions: erasure/erasure.ts rewriteMentions: bumps the content version and writes one redaction row per changed entry (rule 1).
erasure-files: erasure/erasure.ts eraseFiles: bumps the content version and writes one redaction row per bound entry whose file it deleted (rule 1).
import-restore: imports/restore.ts insertImportedRows: INSERT INTO entry_mentions for entries created in the same transaction, in an unclaimed community nobody can read yet, so nothing cached has seen them.
import-teardown: imports/teardown.ts: removes the rows of an import's own unclaimed community, which nobody has ever been able to read; no reader holds a copy.
